scope.focus: Philosophy and logic from absolute first principles through argument analysis, global philosophical traditions, formal and informal logic, core philosophical fields, advanced specialization, and research-grade reading, reasoning, and writing.
includes: Philosophical questioning, argument reconstruction, objections, and charitable interpretation
Informal logic, formal propositional and predicate logic, metalogic, and selected non-classical logics
Epistemology, metaphysics, ethics, political philosophy, aesthetics, philosophy of religion, mind, language, science, mathematics, and technology
Ancient Greek, Indian, Chinese, Islamic, African/Africana, early modern, analytic, continental, feminist, and other globally relevant philosophical traditions
Research-oriented close reading, formalization, literature review, philosophical writing, peer criticism, and open frontier work
